title: Planning documents automation tool
summary: Tool that generates planning documents automatically from a planning software's exports, for a road-construction company.
highlights: Building a tool that generates weekly planning documents, site organisation notes and a long-term tonnage plan from exports of the client's planning software, replacing manual re-entry.
Chose Excel with Power Query, macros and SharePoint, tools the client already uses, so that the client can maintain the solution without a new licence or server.
Adding automatic consistency checks on dates and tonnages, with missing information entered only once.
Preparing a user guide, technical documentation and a training session so that the client can maintain the tool in-house.
